decisions: Explicit semantics and exact structural ownership are never inferred from geometry or metadata-only checks.
PDF2 namespace/UA identification on explicit original figures passes the independent full requested automated profile; complete normative profile coverage and human semantics remain mandatory.
Structure element revision increments preserve source attributes and their prior revision provenance; unsupported role/table/annotation remediation rejects.
Whole-Form ownership and inner Form MCIDs cannot be combined; repeated tagged Form identity, orphan MCIDs and inconsistent parent entries reject.
Independent exact-byte/profile results and explicit matching human attestations remain separate; no actual human/screen-reader review is claimed.
